# BratanOS — GRUB theme.
# Pure-text theme, no binary assets required. A wallpaper is generated by
# /usr/bin/bratanos-grub-install at install time using ImageMagick — if you
# don't run the installer, the theme falls back to a solid background.

title-text: ""
desktop-image: "background.png"
desktop-color: "#1e1e2e"
terminal-box: "terminal_box_*.png"
terminal-font: "Unifont Regular 16"
message-font: "Unifont Regular 16"
message-color: "#cdd6f4"
message-bg-color: "#1e1e2e"

+ image {
    top = 8%
    left = 50%-200
    width = 400
    height = 80
    file = "logo.png"
}

+ label {
    top = 28%
    left = 0
    width = 100%
    align = "center"
    text = "BratanOS — Arch + i3, no trash"
    color = "#89b4fa"
    font = "Unifont Regular 16"
}

+ boot_menu {
    left = 30%
    top = 40%
    width = 40%
    height = 50%
    item_font = "Unifont Regular 16"
    item_color = "#cdd6f4"
    selected_item_font = "Unifont Regular 16"
    selected_item_color = "#1e1e2e"
    selected_item_pixmap_style = "select_*.png"
    item_height = 28
    item_padding = 4
    item_spacing = 4
    icon_width = 0
    icon_height = 0
    item_icon_space = 0
    scrollbar = false
}

+ label {
    bottom = 8%
    left = 0
    width = 100%
    align = "center"
    text = "↑/↓ select   ENTER boot   E edit   C console"
    color = "#6c7086"
    font = "Unifont Regular 16"
}

+ progress_bar {
    id = "__timeout__"
    bottom = 14%
    left = 30%
    width = 40%
    height = 16
    show_text = true
    font = "Unifont Regular 16"
    text_color = "#cdd6f4"
    fg_color = "#89b4fa"
    bg_color = "#313244"
    border_color = "#45475a"
    text = "@TIMEOUT_NOTIFICATION_LONG@"
}
